QuestInfo.name: Attack of the Zombies
QuestInfo.0: The zombies of El Nath attacked the town recently. Scadur wants to discuss this with you.
QuestInfo.1: While Alcaster was away, zombies attacked the town. They were driven off, but they really should be eliminated for the good of the town. Eliminate #b150 Coolie Zombies#k and report back to #bKrag#k in #r#m211041400##k.
QuestInfo.2: You hunted down 150 Coolie Zombies and reported back to Krag in #m211041400#.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 551,961\r\nCan proceed to Signs of Forbidden Magic\r\n

0.0: Did you know? Something terrible happened in El Nath.
0.1: The last time Alcaster was out of El Nath, a whole mess of #bCoolie Zombies#k attacked the town. We drove them off, of course, but I would really prefer not to live in the shadow of undead abominations. For one thing, it hurts property values.
0.2: Now that Alcaster is back and, of course, we have me to protect the town, El Nath isn't in danger. However, since we don't know when something like this will happen again, I'd like to ask for your help.

yes.0: Clearly, the #bCoolie Zombies#k must be wiped out. I'd say about #b150#k of them should put a nice big dent in their numbers. When you're done, let #bKrag#k in #r#m211041400##k know.

no.0: Am I the only one that can fight for this town?

npc.0: #bDefeat 150 Coolie Zombies#k and report back to #bKrag#k in #r#m211041400##k.

mob.0: I'm still seeing #bCoolie Zombies#k roaming the outskirts of town. Make them disappear.
